Highest cached BlendSpace sample has a private engine API. This audit verifies actual active node, weight, speed and input, and identifies jog selection at input(0,600) only by correspondence with the authored sample inventory.

Protected evaluated source/body bones are root/pelvis/head/spines/legs/feet/foot IK. Other upper bones, wrists/finger locals and derived hand IK are reported separately. Per-bone clip modification and idle asset immutability require the separate native frozen source-key audit.

Exact same-frame pose errors are retained even if initial idle phase differs between processes. Normalized BS phase alignment is an explicitly reported diagnostic, not a replacement for frozen asset isolation.

Capture cameras only change render view/visibility. Seven subsequent frames omit automatic first-person cache comparison during restoration; native independently composed head-camera comparison remains active.
The sixteen angular comparisons use normalized per-phase means against the FBX reference mean, not a claim that every individual animation frame or scalar forward projection changes identically.
